kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِصْطَخَمَ • (iṣṭaḵama) VIII (non-past يَصْطَخِمُ (yaṣṭaḵimu), verbal noun اِصْطِخَام (iṣṭiḵām))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root ص خ م (ṣ ḵ m) related to scorching by sun, see صَخَمَ (ṣaḵama). Classical Arabic dictionaries define it as "to stand upright", also adding "silent as if angry", and Lane cites them.
g: The meaning of this term is uncertain. Possibilities include:
to be burnt by the sun, to take sunbath
The meaning of this term is uncertain. Possibilities include:
to stand upright (and silent, as if angry)
